name: W Miami
insider_take: W Miami brings the electric energy of Brickell's financial district to life with its sleek design and rooftop pool overlooking Biscayne Bay.
whats_special: This sophisticated tower sits in the heart of Brickell's banking district, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows with stunning bay and city views. The hotel's signature rooftop pool deck on the 15th floor offers panoramic vistas of downtown Miami's skyline and the bay beyond.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room on higher floors for breathtaking sunrise views over Biscayne Bay and easy access to the Metromover system right outside your door.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime Brickell location puts you steps from the Brickell City Centre shopping complex and a short ride to South Beach. Take advantage of the nearby Brickell Avenue Bridge for stunning sunset photos with the Miami skyline as your backdrop.
pros: Prime Brickell Avenue location with stunning bay and city skyline views
Signature W Hotels contemporary design with vibrant modern amenities
Rooftop pool deck and multiple dining venues including acclaimed restaurants
Walking distance to Miami's financial district and luxury shopping at Brickell City Centre
cons: Urban hotel setting may lack traditional beach resort atmosphere
Premium pricing typical of luxury downtown Miami properties
